gloss: to lower, to take down, to withdraw

definitions.explanation: To move something from a higher to a lower position.
To let someone out of a vehicle.
To take money from an account.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{下|お}ろす。
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{下|お}ろして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please drop me off at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{下|お}ろした。
examples.english: I withdrew money at the bank.
I took the book down from the shelf.

examples.english: To withdraw money from an ATM.

⟦{必要|ひつよう}な→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧{下|お}ろす。

examples.english: To unload luggage from the truck.

examples.japanese: ⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{下|お}ろして⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the taxi driver drop me off in front of the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ATM→ATM：08755_eetiiemu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{五万円|ごまんえん}{下|お}ろしておいた。
examples.english: I withdrew fifty thousand yen from the ATM in advance for the trip.

notes:
{下|お}ろす is a versatile godan verb with several related meanings, all involving the idea of moving something downward or removing it from a higher position.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: ⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ (intransitive — to descend, get off)

KEY MEANINGS:
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{下|お}ろす: to unload luggage
- ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{下|お}ろす: to withdraw money (from bank/ATM)
- ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{下|お}ろす: to drop off a passenger
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{下|お}ろす: to grate (daikon)

HOMOPHONES (different kanji):
- ⟦{卸|おろ}す→卸す：02463_orosu⟧: to sell wholesale
- ⟦{降|お}ろす→降ろす：01923_orosu⟧: to let someone off (a vehicle)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷|に}→荷：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{下|お}ろす: to take a load off one's shoulders (figurative relief)
